name: Chord
description: Plays a chord on every note it is given: a chord for each of the 12 notes, voiced smoothly.

params.description: Chord on C (before Key): 0 none, 1 sus2, 2 minor, 3 major, 4 sus4, 5 minor 7th, 6 7th, 7 major 7th

Shifts the chords up this many semitones (0 = C … 11 = B)
